slots.name: Hooley age
slots.sentence: Hooley, 28, died from his injuries in a hospital in Kyiv three days later - the first British service member to die in Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion in February 2022.

slots.name: death classification
slots.sentence: Darren Salter, senior coroner for Oxfordshire, said he had been provided with "limited evidence" about the circumstances and cause of the explosion but Hooley's death was "not suspicious".

slots.name: Russian territory control
slots.sentence: Russia currently controls about 20% of Ukrainian territory, including a large area of Donetsk.

slots.name: peace talks status
slots.sentence: Peace negotiations to bring an end to the war have also stalled.

slots.name: front line status
slots.sentence: After almost five years of war, the front line in Ukraine remains largely stagnant with both sides failing to make significant gains.

slots.name: regiment join date
slots.sentence: Hooley, from Wallingford in Oxfordshire, joined the regiment in June 2016 after completing his training at the Infantry Training Centre Catterick in North Yorkshire.
